comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Reopened: customer on tenant_id tnt_88c still saw "Acme Robotics Staging" flash this morning after our fix. They use a shared device kiosk; investigating whether service worker is caching the old shell HTML.

content.text: Reopened: customer on tenant_id tnt_88c still saw "Acme Robotics Staging" flash this morning after our fix. They use a shared device kiosk; investigating whether service worker is caching the old shell HTML.

For a brief moment after hard-loading the customer portal, the header shows another tenant's workspace display name before swapping to the correct one. Duration is usually 200–600 ms; long enough for a screenshot and a security-conscious customer to file an NMS ticket.

Expected: never paint a workspace name that does not belong to the authenticated session. Actual: first paint uses a cached shell value from localStorage key nimbus.portal.lastWorkspaceLabel without checking it against the session tenant_id.
Cross-tenant label flash is a confidentiality concern even if ticket bodies never leak. Session bootstrap should either wait for /me or clear the label when tenant_id mismatches.
